title: FBI-UAP-D004, FD-1057-02, Northeastern United States, 2024
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-1057 communication document regarding a civilian's report of anomalous lights and associated physical effects; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: A civilian reported repeated observations of anomalous lights or plasma orbs near their residence, accompanied by spikes in Gamma radiation and electronic/GPS interference.
encounters.quote: objects appearing to be unknown UxS or UAP near residence
